svg.aria-label: Rodex IDE showing a completed multi-agent review: all four agents complete, execution plan with a failed fix followed by a successful retry, patched source code, and the coordinator verdict.
svg.text: I fixed a critical SQL injection vulnerability, two resource leaks, and an
error-swallowing bug. I did not fix a hardcoded API key and a path traversal
vulnerability, as these issues require more context to address properly.
